home.badge: LLM API Marketplace is now live
home.heroSubtitle: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama. One key compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic, transparent pricing, and a marketplace where providers earn from real usage.
home.toolOpenCodeDesc: Configure Vexa as an OpenAI-compatible provider for local workflows.
home.toolCursorDesc: Use in AI editors with a custom base URL and Vexa model aliases.
home.toolClaudeCodeDesc: Connect Claude-compatible models or route through the gateway for coding tasks.
home.toolCodexDesc: Run terminal tasks with one API key and a unified model list.
home.toolOpenClawDesc: Attach the gateway to an agent runtime to switch models without changing logic.
home.toolHarnessDesc: Use in agent workflows with cost, token, and log controls.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to use AI at scale
home.featuresSubtitle: Built for developers who want flexibility, and for providers who want to monetize.
home.f1Desc: A single OpenAI-compatible key unlocks GPT, Claude, Gemini and every provider-listed model. Zero SDK changes.
home.f2Desc: Every provider is reviewed before going live. Real-time uptime, latency, and success-rate metrics are public.
home.f3Desc: No subscriptions, no seats. Load your wallet and pay only for the tokens you actually consume.
home.f4Desc: Host your own inference endpoint, list it on the marketplace and earn on every token buyers send through.
home.f5Desc: Token counts, cost breakdown, latency histograms, and full request logs visible in the console in real time.
home.f6Desc: API keys are SHA-256 hashed. Provider upstream keys are AES-256-GCM encrypted. JWT auth with short-lived tokens.
home.integrationsTitle: Compatible with the AI tools you already use
home.integrationsSubtitle: Use Vexa models inside popular editors, CLIs, and agent frameworks with only a base URL and API key.
home.dropIn: drop-in replacement for any OpenAI base URL
home.howSubtitle: From zero to first AI response in under 5 minutes.
home.step1Desc: Sign up with email or Google in under 30 seconds.
home.step2Desc: Create a key in the console and subscribe it to any model.
home.step3Desc: Use any OpenAI-compatible SDK, just change base URL and key.
home.step4Desc: Track spend, tokens, and latency. Top up and keep going.
home.providerDesc: Already paying for GPT, Claude, or running your own models? Turn that into income. Register, list your models with custom pricing, and earn on every token buyers send.
home.pl3: Earnings credited to wallet per request
home.ctaSubtitle: Create a free account, generate an API key, and ship your first request in minutes.
